overview_description.description: The Mawada Project provides participants the opportunity to develop essential soft skills like empathy, communication, and adaptability while giving back to others. Their events touch the lives of those with unmet needs and are centred on one or more of our five themes, such as education, healthcare, refugees, special abilities, and sustainable development.
